name: energy-combinator-21-enhanced
title: Energy Combinator 2.1 Enhanced
author: ener156 (fork of VinDust / dodo.the.last)
description: Independent community-maintained Factorio 2.1 fork of Energy Combinator (VinDust), based on Power Combinator (dodo.the.last). Current and estimated maximum power signals, accumulator energy/capacity, quality-aware MK2 filters, new GUI, scaling/rounding and multiplayer edit locks. Global networks experimental; 7seg optional.
